caption: The video captures a hydraulic press above an upright red Coca‑Cola can resting on a dark‑topped, yellow‑edged platform, against a plain backdrop and a black‑and‑yellow striped base. In the opening frames a translucent ghost image of the press and can, with a beige smear at the can's left, fades as the press head lowers. The yellow rim of the descending cylinder meets the top of the can within the first half second. After this contact the can remains upright and essentially undeformed through a long static interval while the press head stays against its top. Then the left side of the can suddenly ruptures. A beige foamy spray bursts outward, traveling leftward and downward as it widens. The ejected material clouds the space beside the can while the press head remains against its top. The can stays largely upright as the spray keeps expanding.
